connection_rules.rule: The KeyLab does not generate audible sound. Send its MIDI to a software instrument, XPS-30, or other sound module, then route that sound source's audio separately.
The five-pin MIDI OUT is a documented direct path for controlling hardware synth modules. It can also act as MIDI Thru for host-generated MIDI through the USB DINTHRU endpoint.
The KeyLab USB-C connection needs a computer or other compatible USB host. It is not a direct USB connection to the XPS-30 USB COMPUTER port.

Use the standard MIDI endpoint for notes and normal MIDI controls. Use the dedicated MCU/HUI endpoint only when configuring a DAW control surface, since enabling it unnecessarily can produce unwanted MIDI events from transport controls.
